title: Krishna & Your Child — A Story of Joy & Friendship
shortDesc: Lord Krishna plays his flute and calls your child by name, taking them on a joyful Vrindavan adventure full of friendship, music and magic.
fullDesc:
Lord Krishna smiles and says: '[Child's Name], come — let us play together in Vrindavan!'

In this enchanting storybook, your child becomes Krishna's special friend. Together they dance with peacocks, float boats on the Yamuna, and learn that true friendship means lifting each other up.

A timeless gift celebrating the divine bond between a child and Lord Krishna — personalised just for them!

title: Ganesha Blesses Your Child's Every New Beginning
shortDesc: Lord Ganesha taps your child's shoulder and speaks their name — reminding them that every new beginning is filled with possibilities and blessings.
fullDesc:
With a warm smile, Lord Ganesha says: '[Child's Name], I am here — let us begin this journey together!'

This heartwarming storybook features Ganesha as your child's personal guide through every first — first day of school, first challenge, first success. Together, they learn that obstacles are just opportunities in disguise.

A perfect gift for birthdays, Ganesh Chaturthi, or any new milestone in your child's life!

title: Hanuman Gives Your Child the Strength to Never Give Up
shortDesc: Hanuman stretches out his mighty hand and calls your child by name — filling them with courage, determination and the belief that they can overcome anything.
fullDesc:
With a thunderous roar and a gentle heart, Hanuman says: '[Child's Name], with devotion and courage — nothing is impossible!'

This powerful storybook follows your child on a Ramayana-inspired adventure alongside Hanuman. They discover the strength that comes from love, faith, and never giving up.

A wonderful gift for children who need a boost of confidence and courage!

title: Kali Maa Gives Your Child Fearless Strength
shortDesc: Maa Kali reaches out to your child by name, wrapping them in her divine protection and teaching them that inner strength and fearlessness conquer all fears.
fullDesc:
Maa Kali says with fierce love: '[Child's Name], you are never alone — my strength is yours!'

A powerful and comforting storybook that teaches children about fearlessness and the protective love of Maa Kali. Through a Navratri-inspired adventure, your child learns that courage and inner strength live in every heart.

A beautiful Navratri or Dussehra gift for children!

title: Saraswati Whispers Your Child's Name & Sparks Their Genius
shortDesc: Goddess Saraswati sits beside your child and whispers their name, sparking a love for learning, music and the gift of knowledge.
fullDesc:
Goddess Saraswati smiles and says: 'Dear [Child's Name], you have the greatest gift — a curious mind!'

This beautiful storybook brings Saraswati Devi to life as your child's favourite teacher. Together they explore the wonders of music, art, and the joy of learning new things every day.

Ideal before school starts or as a Saraswathi Puja gift!

title: Siva Shows Your Child the Way of Peace
shortDesc: Lord Siva opens his eyes and calls your child's name, teaching them that true peace and power come from stillness, kindness, and a calm heart.
fullDesc:
From the peaks of Kailash, Lord Siva opens his eyes and says: '[Child's Name], come — I have a story of stars and stillness for you…'

This magical storybook brings the gentle and powerful side of Siva to your child — teaching mindfulness, inner calm, and how to be kind even when things are hard.

A unique, soothing bedtime story that children and parents will both love.

title: Lakshmi Brings Your Child Abundance & Gratitude
shortDesc: Goddess Lakshmi steps off her lotus and sprinkles golden blessings, teaching your child the magic of gratitude, sharing, and a giving heart.
fullDesc:
Goddess Lakshmi smiles and says: 'Dear [Child's Name], the greatest wealth is a grateful heart!'

This golden storybook weaves Lakshmi Devi's blessings into a Diwali-inspired adventure. Your child learns why sharing is the biggest treasure of all — and how a thankful heart attracts all good things.

A perfect Diwali gift and a treasure every child will return to again and again!

title: Murugan Guides Your Child to Victory
shortDesc: Lord Murugan rides his peacock and calls your child's name, taking them on a Tamil legend adventure filled with determination and the sweetness of victory.
fullDesc:
With his vel raised, Lord Murugan says: '[Child's Name], you were born to win!'

This vibrant storybook celebrates Murugan — the eternal young God of Tamil Nadu. Your child joins him on an adventure where they learn that persistence, hard work and faith always lead to victory.

A wonderful gift for families in Tamil Nadu — especially around Karthigai Deepam and Thai Pongal!

title: Vishnu Protects Your Child Across Every World
shortDesc: Lord Vishnu descends from Vaikuntha and calls your child's name — teaching them that righteousness, kindness and truth always protect those with a good heart.
fullDesc:
Lord Vishnu smiles from his lotus throne and says: '[Child's Name], dharma is your greatest shield!'

Set in the cosmic world of the Puranas, this storybook brings Vishnu — the preserver of the universe — as your child's personal protector. They learn about doing what is right, being kind to all, and how truth always triumphs.

A classic tale of divine love and protection, personalised just for your child.
